note: Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). Only the standard 18 rounds of RFC 1319 exist; CyberChef's Rounds parameter is not supported.

Parameters size (bits, a multiple of 8, 8 to 512, default 256), levels (L, 0 to 64, default 64) and key (up to 64 bytes), with CyberChef's defaults. Sizes that are not a multiple of 8 bits are not supported. The round count is the report's default (40 + size/4, at least 80 with a key).
FIPS 180 (1993). Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). Only the standard 80 rounds exist; a Rounds parameter is not supported.
One word with a size choice of 128, 160, 256 or 320 (default 320, as in CyberChef). Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). ripemd160:digest also exists, for HMAC.
MD4 of the UTF-16LE text (MS-NLMP NTOWFv1), 16 raw bytes. Takes text, not bytes.
